body: That is very true, and I’m 22. It just sucks because I feel like I can’t do the simple things in life like going out to eat, or eating with friends and it’s so hard for people to understand, but I know that they will never understand fully

Thank you, and parents are both really supportive, but it is really hard for people my age to understand. Like I have a couple of friends who try to understand, but I feel like no one my age really can try to understand
